description: Detect what a website is built with from its HTML, scripts and headers: framework or site builder, analytics and session replay, ad pixels, CRM and forms, support chat, payments, auth, consent banner, monitoring and fonts — each with the evidence that matched and a link to the products on MakerRadar built with it — plus whether the page is served by the server or rendered by scripts, and the third-party hosts it loads. One fetch as our crawler after robots.txt; stores nothing. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The public page to check (https://…). A bare host means its homepage.

name: detect_tech

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.

title: Detect the tech stack
